verdict.rationale: Floot has a dedicated custom-domains doc page stating you can point your own domain at your Floot app so it is served from your address instead of its *.floot.app subdomain. This builds on its one-click publish, so the core story is delivered first-party. missing for 10: DNS/verification steps, SSL/HTTPS provisioning details, plan requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect a custom domain to my published app

citations.quote: Point your own domain at your Floot app so it is served from your own address instead of its *.floot.app subdomain.
Just one click “publish” and you're live.
